_comment: Every global gameplay number. Source: design doc 'Starting numbers' tab (2026-10-22) unless marked 'placeholder'. All first drafts: tune in playtests.

player._stamina: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.6 (ER): 45/s after 0.5 s (Raven's first draft was 30/s after 0.8 s). Paused while guarding, sprinting and from an attack's press until its cancel window opens.
player._wake: respawnSeconds: the wait before the death screen's Wake button works. autoWakeSeconds > 0: wake at your pick after that long without pressing it (0: wait for you).
player._movement: FULL-GAME 9: 0.15 s to full speed (maxAcceleration cm/s/s), a quick stop (brakingDeceleration, brakingFriction with separate braking friction on), groundFriction for turns.
player._poise: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.5: a player's poise comes from armour (items.json equip.poise) and nodes (Tempered); poise damage adds up and resets to full poiseResetSeconds after the last poise hit, and at once after a reaction (ER).

beds._comment: Beds and bedrolls (WRBeds): a bed you just woke at rests restSeconds before you can wake there again; a bedroll is used up when you wake on it (bedrollSingleUse 1). placeholder

stamina._stamina: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.6: roll 12 at every load, backstep 8, jump 8. Melee costs come from Data/weapons.json moves. graceFloor: an action starts with any stamina left and may take it this far below zero (ER's last swing); nothing starts while it's below zero. A refused press flashes the stamina bar for refuseFlashSeconds and shakes it refuseShake px. A blocked hit costs the blow's staminaDamage x (1 - guard boost / 100) (weapons.json guard / offhands).

weapon._riposte: Crits (ripostes, backstabs, stance-break crits) use the weapon class's crit multipliers in Data/weapons.json; light/heavy timing and stamina for weapons with a class are its moves there.

defense._comment: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.2, 1.3, 1.7 (cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.3-3.4). load: the roll by equip load (worn + held kg / (maxEquipLoad + the equipLoad stat)): light below lightBelow, medium below mediumBelow, heavy below 1, overloaded at or over it (a slow step, no i-frames); distance cm covered over travel s, i-frames from iStart to iEnd s, the roll ends at max(travel, iEnd) + recovery. backstep: Dodge with the stick at rest. jumpLegInvuln: s after take-off that blows flagged low (ground waves, tail sweeps, stomps) pass under. Guard: blockStun s after a blocked light (impact <= 2) / heavy blow, then guardCounterWindow s in which Heavy is the guard counter; parryTapSeconds: letting go of Guard sooner is a committed parry (its recovery plays); a press within parrySpamWindow s of the last shrinks the parry window by parrySpamShrink. perfectDodgeSeconds: a blow the roll's i-frames take this soon after it starts is a perfect dodge (Event.PerfectDodge: Frozen moment). ledgeDrop: a roll stops at an edge with more than this drop unless the stick still holds toward it (ledgeStickDot). creature/bossStaminaDamage: what a blocked creature or boss blow costs (x its damage) before the guard boost.

combat._full: Full attack set (cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.2-2.4): charge (Heavy held: min s to count, full s for the charged row's whole damage, max s it lets go by itself), contextWindow s after a roll / backstep for the rolling / backstep light, runAttackSpeed cm/s for a running attack, jumpAttack (maxAir s the blade stays live in the air, landGrace s after landing, heavyRadius x its sweep), counterHit (on a body winding up: damage, pierceDamage, stance), stealth (an unaware target: stance, buildup), twoHand (a 1h weapon held in both: damage, lightStance, heavyStance), minArtWindup / minHeavyCoil (the coil rule).
combat._comment: Feel and commitment (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.16, L2; cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.2). bufferSeconds: a press that can't start yet waits this long (the last press wins); a dodge pressed mid-swing waits up to dodgeBufferMax for the cancel window. comboFraction: the last part of a swing's recovery in which the next chain attack starts; cancelFraction: from this share of the recovery a roll or guard cuts the swing (lights / heavies). chainGrace: s after a swing ends in which a light still continues its chain. stepIn: the lock target (else the nearest enemy within range cm and cone degrees) pulls the swing in toward ideal x reach off its body, min..max cm (shorter steps are skipped), over stepFraction of the wind-up. lightMoveMultiplier: the legs keep walking at this speed while a light swings (heavies root you). clipWarp: the swing clip is timed so its contact frames land on the active window: the coil plays at most maxCoilRate (a longer lead-in starts later), below minRate it holds the first frame instead of crawling, the strike plays between activeMin and activeMax x. windowsFromClips 1 lets the clips' own notifies set the windows (0: the move rows do, the same on every machine and the server).

crit._comment: Critical attacks (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.3, 1.4; cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.4). Light on a target whose stance is broken (or a guard-broken player) from its front (frontArc degrees, within stanceCritRange cm of its body; big = radius over bigRadius) is a riposte; from behind (backstabArc, PvP pvpBackstabArc) within backstabRange of a body no bigger than backstabMaxRadius / backstabMaxHalfHeight that isn't winding up, a backstab (big ones only while broken). The attacker warps to syncDistance cm off its body over warpSeconds, is invulnerable until the damage frame (ripostePaired / backstabPaired damageAt of total s), and the target is held until damageAt + holdAfter. parryOpenSeconds: how long a parry that breaks leaves it open; parryInterruptSeconds: the stagger of one that doesn't. exposed: a parried creature takes exposedDamage x from everyone for exposedSeconds (Valheim). guardBrokenRiposte: s a guard-broken player can be riposted. pvpDamage x on players, riseIFrames for the victim after.

stance._parts: Breakable parts and head strikes (combat.md 2.10): a strike within headRadius cm of the head lock point x headStrikeMult stance; a blow within partRadius cm of a part takes its stance too; broken: partStaggerSeconds stagger and partBreakBodyStance of the body's stance.
stance._comment: Creature and boss stance (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.4): a hidden meter by tier (creatures.json stance overrides); hits take it down by their stance damage (weapons.json moves; spells and creatures' own blows by damage x spellPerDamage / creaturePerDamage; a shatter x shatterMult). It starts refilling max / regenDelayDivisor s after the last stance hit, at regenPerSecond (x lowHealthRegen below half health, Sekiro). At zero it breaks for breakSeconds by tier: the crit opens. Bosses take stance damage x group.<participants> (4 or more: group.4; tames count). Parries: parriesToBreak by kind; a parry that doesn't break takes nonBreakParryStance of max. slump: the broken body's head drops pitch degrees and it sinks by sink x its half height over seconds.

poise._comment: Poise (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.5; combat.md 2.5). A player whose poise breaks reacts by the blow's impact (1 flinch, 2 stagger, 3+ heavy stagger: s locked); a blow that doesn't break it is a shudder. Creatures flinch for creatureFlinchSeconds unless they're attacking with hyperarmor (creatures.json hyperarmor, bosses). The hyperarmor window of a heavy (wind-up to the end of its strike) multiplies poise by hyperarmor.heavy and takes hyperarmorDamageTaken less damage.

net._comment: Server rewind (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.17; cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.4): every character's body is kept for history s at sampleHz. A player's swing and crit are judged against bodies where that player saw them (its ping / 2 + interpSeconds, at most rewindMax). A creature's or boss's blow on a remote player waits up to its ping + interp (at most rewindMax) for the defence it pressed when it saw the blow.

paths._xp_per_use: placeholder: 60,500 XP per path ~ 80 h at 1x

resources._all: placeholder: doc defines behaviour only (Heat builds, boosts damage, stops at full; Chill fills slowly, spending it all makes bigger shatters)

status._full: Every status (cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.9, combat.md 2.11): a meter fills per hit and procs at the threshold (thresholds by tier; players 100 + worn resist), x procGrowth after each proc until resetAfterCombat s without a blow; bosses x bossParticipantResist per extra participant. infusedBuildup: what an infused weapon's light / heavy / charged blow builds. defs: each status's colour (sRGB hex, on the bars) and proc numbers.

nodeEffects._comment: Per-rank effect of each stat node (path.node -> stat -> amount per rank). Placeholders; ability nodes are separate abilities. blastRadius: fire area spells, Explosive bolt and Overheat reach further (x 1 + it). slowStrength: Slowed from your frost goes that much deeper (x 1 - it). areaRadius: frost area spells (Frost nova, Ice wall spacing, Blizzard) grow by it.

spells._shapes: Spell shapes (combat.md 2.13): wind-up and recovery s; roots 1 = you stand to cast (walls, novas, Meteor, Blizzard), 0 = you walk at half speed (bolts, lances, pools). A spell with chargeable 1 charges while its key is held: x chargeDamage at chargeMax s.
spells._lock: With a target locked on, bolts aim ahead of where it's going (lockLead 0 = at where it is), then curve toward it: cm/s/s, less against other players so they can dodge. A target past lockRange cm isn't aimed at.

fx._comment: Combat feel and effect budgets (WRFx; the effects themselves are recipes in Data/fx.json). Client-side only. hitStop: how long both fighters' animation freezes on heavy blows (heavy swings, weapon arts, crits, ripostes, shatters, guard breaks) and parries, seconds. shake.<moment>: camera trauma 0..1 added (radius > 0: fades with distance from the camera, for slams and spells), scale = master (0 turns shaking off), maxAngle degrees / maxOffset cm at full trauma, decay per second, frequency of the wobble. impact.heavyScale = how much bigger a heavy blow's sparks/blood are, elementScale = the fire/frost burst on an infused or path melee hit. hud: hit marker and parry flash (seconds, alpha). Budgets: sprites per batch, pooled lights, distances (cm) for one-shots, drawing and lights. ambient/lava/weather: fires on Hearths and torches, statuses, lava embers, snow and ash (ridge distances from x = 0, cm).
fx._hitStack: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS L1 (cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.2): hitStop s by tier (both bodies' animation creeps at creep x, then catches up over catchUp s; it starts deepFraction of the strike after contact, at most deepMax s later, so it freezes at the blade's deepest point); weight by tier drives the camera (trauma base + scale x w^2 for the people in it, an FOV punch of base + scale x w degrees easing out over seconds), the pad (base + scale x w ms at strength x w; lights only the small motor) and the victim's shake (min..max cm at hz: the body, not the camera); flash: the victim's flash s by tier (parries gold) at opacity.

creature._biteTrack: during a bite's wind-up the creature stands still and turns toward its target at biteTrackRate deg/s for the first biteTrackFraction of the wind-up, then commits (a late step aside makes it miss)

hazards._comment: Biome gear checks: lava river (needs lava resistance), slick ice (needs ice resistance). lavaMinDepth (cm): the drawn lava must stand this far over the ground for a spot to burn (its rim dips under the ground).

lava._comment: How the lava flow is drawn (AWRDressing::BuildLavaFlow, M_Lava; try live with wr.LavaParam): glow x everything; hotLevel / crustLevel the glow of molten rock / cold crust; crackPower thins the glowing cracks; moltenCore how much of the flow's middle is molten; steady 0..1 holds the glow at one brightness on screen whatever the exposure; farLiftPer100m (cm) lifts far lava over the coarser far landscape; cullDistance (cm); chunkPoints grid points per chunk side (2 m each).

sky._comment: How the clock looks (WRSky): sun height at noon and depth at midnight (degrees), the moon's light (lux; the map's sun is ~10) and how far above the opposite of the sun it rides, the sky light at night (x the map's), and the dimmest auto-exposure may go (EV100: higher = darker nights). placeholder
sky._air: The air by biome (polish pass): the camera's side of the ridge (X; blend biomeWidth cm wide around biomeCentre) picks haze colour (sRGB) and density, the grade (white balance K: higher = warmer, saturation, gain r,g,b) and blends across. nightFogColor is linear. A low sun (below goldenHourBelow degrees) adds light shafts (bloom, threshold, occlusion darkness, tint) and a warm glow in the fog toward it. The valley mist is a local fog volume in each hollow of Data/valley_fog.json (node Tools/terrain/valleys.mjs), lifted mistLift cm, radius x mistRadiusScale: density mistDensity x (mistDay..mistNight by daylight, + mistDawn / mistDusk around dawn and dusk), height falloff (engine units: higher = thinner layer) and offset, albedo by side (sRGB). shadowLift (linear, x nightShadowLift at night) keeps blacks from crushing. volumetricFog 1 turns on volumetric fog (costs GPU).

sea._comment: The sea (WRSea, polish pass): the WaterMaterials ocean at level cm over the open sea of Data/sea_mask.json (node Tools/terrain/sea_mask.mjs), in squares one mask cell (4 m) wide at the shore growing to distance / falloff (bigger falloff = finer far out) up to maxSquare cm, out to extent cm across, split into tile cm meshes near the island (8x that further out); uvScale cm per texture repeat. dim: material parameters with their daytime values that dim to nightDim x at night (glow, foam glow, painted highlights, sky reflection). scalars / colours (sRGB) set any of the material's parameters by name.

audio._comment: Where wading footsteps and the surf bed start: seaLevel cm, the drawn sea surface (the sea mesh is at -20 but its material draws the waterline about 80 cm higher, see water.surfaceOffset).

water._comment: Swimming and drinking (UWRWaterSubsystem, feedback pass): a water volume over the open sea of Data/sea_mask.json from floor cm up to the drawn surface (sea.level + surfaceOffset: the sea's material draws its surface about that much above the mesh, measured from the beach waterline), out to extent cm from the middle (map: the map it's built on when the mask doesn't say). You swim while the capsule's middle is under the surface (the ground about a metre down): buoyancy (above 1 floats higher: at 1.6 the capsule's middle sits a quarter metre under the surface, the eyes 40 cm over it), swimSpeed cm/s; the body art rides swimLift cm higher on the capsule while swimming along (lying on the surface) and treadLift while treading water; friction the water's drag (what slows you when you stop swimming); braking cm/s2 stays 0 (the engine stops any slow speed dead under braking, so a body under the surface would never float up). E drinks in the water or at its edge (feet at most drinkReach cm above the surface, water at least drinkMinDepth cm deep within drinkRange cm in front): drinkThirst Water per gulp, one every drinkSeconds; seaDrinkable 0 makes the sea too salty. Creatures wade up to creatureWade x their half-height (checked creatureLookAhead cm past their radius) and turn back from deeper water. Swim sounds within soundRange cm, a stroke every strokeSeconds. The fall-through rescue (WRGameMode): a swimmer with the landscape more than rescueMargin cm over it is under the island and put back on top; the rescue traces down from rescueTraceTop cm, and holds anyone who falls below voidZ cm (under the sea floor) there until the ground over them has streamed in. placeholder
water._fast: Sprint in the water is the fast stroke: fastSwimMultiplier x the swim speed, fastSwimStamina stamina a second (Strong stroke halves it, Seaborn makes it free); the swimming skill adds its every-level speed.

camera._comment: Third-person camera (WRCameraBoom, polish pass): the wall / tree probe radius cm; how fast the camera eases back out after something pulled it in (it always pulls in at once); degrees the view widens while sprinting and how fast; lock-on turns start at lockOnStartSpeed and firm up to lockOnSpeed over lockOnEaseSeconds. Lock-on takes what's visible within lockOnRange cm and lockOnAngle degrees of the crosshair, nearest it (lockOnDistanceWeight degrees is what being at the far end of the range counts for); it lets go past lockOnKeepRange cm or after lockOnLostSeconds out of sight.
camera._full: cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.19 (CAL 1.15): the arm collides only with walls, cliffs and big rocks (the WRCamera channel; props and bodies ignore it), pulls in at once, holds holdSeconds, then eases out over easeOutSeconds; the hero hides under hideUnder cm from the lens. Giant framing: a lock target taller than giantRatio x you pulls the arm back giantBoom cm and pitches the view up giantPitch degrees (over giantSeconds). Mouse flick: a sideways mouse sweep of mouseFlickPx px/s with a lock on switches target (flickRearm s between).

bosses._full: The attack machine (cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.16): bands (close / mid cm) pick rows by their weights; a move never three times running (maxRepeats); things in the air at once (projectilesInFlight p1 / p2); idle gaps after a string (idleGap p1 / p2 min-max s); tracking turns at trackRate deg/s through a row's track share; slam waves roll at waveSpeed cm/s, waveDepth deep; dives come down at diveSpeed. Shrine-stones (runbackStone) min-max cm from the arena, height / width cm, rune light. First-kill drops rise firstKillRise cm/s, fly at firstKillFlySpeed after firstKillFlySeconds or within firstKillPickup cm. Roaming minis walk their loop at roamInput. Cinderhorn's basalt pillars (basaltWidth / Height / Sink cm) take pillarCharges charges.
bosses._comment: Shared boss rules, then per-boss overrides: bosses.<id>.<attack>.damage/windup/cooldown/range/size, bosses.<id>.health/arenaRadius/chaseRadius/... (see WRBoss.cpp for every key). arenaRadius (30 m major, 22 m mini) is the floor its floods and props cover; it chases, and counts as fighting, anyone within chaseRadiusMajor / Mini cm of its home. With nobody there for resetSeconds (8) it resets and walks home; one that isn't home after returnStuckSeconds is put back.
bosses._flags: bosses.<id>.<attack>.parryable / low / grab / unblockable / impact (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.3, 1.13): only parryable blows can be parried (boss grabs like the tongs are), low ones pass under a jump, grabs ignore hyperarmor and guards. Blocked boss blows cost defense.bossStaminaDamage x damage before the guard boost.

ranged._comment: Bows, crossbows, blowguns, spears, bolas (weapon numbers are in items.json). Aiming camera arm cm / fov / walk speed x; hip-fire spread; throw release s; projectile radius cm, flight s, stuck s, stick depth cm; bola roots creatures up to this radius cm, else slows; poise per damage; grip cm from the wrist; durability per shot. placeholder

taming._comment: Knockout taming, ARK-style. Seconds above = seconds of eating plain food (what it eats); a knocked-out creature eats one item from its stash every secondsPerFood, kibble counts kibbleValue x. Torpor: max = health x torporPerHealth, drains per second (fraction of max) awake / unconscious; a narcotic adds narcoticTorpor of max. Effectiveness starts at 1, loses effectivenessPerHit per hit while it's out and effectivenessPerPlainMeal per non-kibble meal; the tame gets health and bite x (1 + effectiveness x bonusAtFull). Waking keeps wakeKeepsProgress of the progress. A tame told to stay only fights within stayGuardRadius cm of its post. placeholder
taming._whistle: The whistle (H, or hold Interact with nothing in front): every tame of yours within whistleRange cm takes the order; a tap of H calls them (follow), holding past whistleHoldSeconds opens its wheel.

lifeSkills._xp: XP per action. swim: per metre swum; catch: per fish landed (x1.6 uncommon, x2.5 rare, x6 legendary); machineItem: per item a station finishes for you (engineering), machinePlace: placing a station or a code-lock door, machineLock: the first code on a door.
lifeSkills._perks: Perk reach: backstabFrontDegrees (a backstab is a hit from outside the creature's front this wide), packLeaderRange cm, vanishRange cm (creatures on you this close lose sight on a dodge), sharedMealRange cm, selfRepairQuietSeconds (no damage this long before stations and doors mend). hud: prospectRange / prospectLabelRange cm (ore marks / their names), predatorRange cm, predatorRing (the pip ring's radius, share of the screen's short side).

fishing._comment: Fishing (WRFishing.cpp; fish in Data/fish.json). Hold the attack chargeSeconds for the longest cast (castMin..castMax cm); it must land on water at least minDepth cm deep (shallow under openDepth, deep over deepDepth with Deep line). A bite comes biteMin..biteMax s after it lands (/ 1 + the fishing skill's bite speed, x baitBiteFactor with bait), after 1-3 nibbles; strike within hookWindow s. Hooked: holding the attack reels reelSpeed cm/s (a fifth during a surge) for reelStamina stamina/s; tension rises tensionReel/s while reeling (tensionSurge/s in a surge) x (0.55 + fight), falls tensionRelax/s when you ease off (a surging fish runs runSpeed x (0.5 + fight) cm/s); snapSeconds at full tension snaps it (wearPerSnap on the rod). Landed within landCm, or dragged into the shallows. More than castMax + extraLine out: it's gone. Walking leashCm from where you cast reels in. rarityWeight: odds by rarity; lureRareBoost: a biome lure's boost to rare fish. placeholder

gathering._comment: The island's trees, rocks and shrubs (Data/island_dressing.json). perHit is before the tool's yield, the server gatherMultiplier and life skills (heavy hits x2); hits until it's used up; minutes until it grows back. placeholder

gather._comment: Held tools and harvestable bodies (the gather pass, 0.5). tools: durability lost per gathering hit with the right tool held (wearPerHit) or with anything else, a sword or the wrong tool (wearOther); used as a weapon a tool wears as a sword does (1 a hit); broken it gathers at the base rate and hits for brokenDamage x its damage until repaired at a workbench. toolLook: the modelled hand tools' sizes (WRToolMesh, cm; the rod's too). body: a wild creature's kill stays down lifetimeSeconds to be butchered by hitting it (gone sooner once emptied). Its loot (creatures.json, x the server's gatherMultiplier) is split over hits = its loot units / unitsPerHit (minHits..maxHits); a heavy hit takes two. A blade in hand (a hatchet or a sword) keeps everything a hit takes, bare hands or a pick bareShare of it; the killer (and their clan) has it to themselves for claimSeconds; hintRange (cm) shows the one-time hit-the-body hint. placeholder

building._foundationSink: cm a new foundation sits into the ground at its centre, so its floor (100 up) is a walkable step. placeholder
building._steps: cm: the fine grid's lines for walls and pillars; furniture's marks on a foundation or floor, on the grid and on the fine grid; the marks' size; how far down a piece aimed past your reach looks for the ground.
building._turning: A free piece: degrees a tap of the rotate key turns it, a wheel notch, seconds before a held key starts to spin it, degrees a second it spins.
building._spill: A chest broken or demolished with things in it leaves them in a bag where it stood, anyone's to take, for spillMinutes.

ui._comment: Build bar demolish mode: the piece under the crosshair glows (unlit, x demolishGlow; brighter washes out) red when a click takes it down, grey when it can't; the crosshair finds pieces out to demolishReach cm from the camera (beyond 11 m from you they say too far). placeholder

flow._comment: The moments between play (WRUIFlow): the death screen and its fades; the Loading the island cover, held until World Partition has streamed streamRadius cm around you (at most streamMaxSeconds), shown after a jump of teleportCm or more; screens ease in over screenInSeconds; notices queue (each up noticeSeconds, at least noticeMinSeconds when others wait); banners, toasts and hints; discovery radii by place kind (cm); menuCamera is the main menu backdrop (cm, degrees). placeholder

craft._comment: Crafting time at stations (AWRStation::Queue, 0.7): each of a recipe takes its recipes.json seconds x timeScale / the world's craftMultiplier (timeScale 0: at once, as before; tests of what's made use it). An order is up to maxPerOrder of one recipe, its inputs taken when it's ordered; a station holds queueOrders orders and makes them one after another, with nobody at it. Each one made goes into its maker's bag while they're within deliverRange cm of the station, else into its tray of traySlots slots; with neither room, it waits. Hand recipes stay instant. placeholder

inventory._comment: The bag: carrying more than carryKg (bag + worn + held) slows you to overweightSpeed; dropped items lie in a bag for dropMinutes. placeholder

wildlife._comment: Island wildlife (WRWildlife): packs live on when nobody is near, on the walk map (Data/island_walk.json, from Tools/terrain/walkmap.mjs), and comes from the regions in Data/spawn_regions.json. A pack comes out when a player is within activationRadius cm of it and fades away after despawnSeconds with nobody within activationRadius x leaveRadiusMult (tamed and knocked-out creatures stay). enabled 0: no packs. placeholder
wildlife._roam: stepSeconds: how often the server moves them (timeScale: wildlife time per second, for tests). travelSpeed: their walk, times the kind's speed; huntSpeed: on a hunt, times that. grazeMin/MaxMinutes: how long they stay; grazeMin/MaxDistance (cm): how far to the next feeding ground. wander*: packs that travel far (creatures.json wanderChance). territoryRadius, prowlMinDistance (cm): where predators keep to. huntSight, catchRadius (cm), huntChance, fedHours, missedHours: hunts nobody sees. healPerHour: wounds mending. spawnCheckSeconds: how often (in wildlife time) each region is checked against its target; spawnPacksPerCheck: the most new packs a region gets at one check; spawnAwayFromPlayers / spawnAwayFromBuildings (cm): how far from every player and anything built a new pack starts (never in a land claim). leadDistance, catchUpDistance (cm), travelInput: creatures following their pack in view. packSkew over 1: mostly small packs.

raid._comment: Creature raids on land claims (WRRaids), by the world's 'Creature raids' setting (server.raids: off / rare / normal / frequent): a claim's next raid comes rareHours / normalHours / frequentHours of game time after its last (or after it was put up), give or take jitter. It waits until someone of the claim (its owner or their clan) is within homeRange cm of the totem: creatures only exist near players, so nobody's base is raided while they're away. warnSeconds: the warning before they come. They come from spawnDistance cm outside the claim's edge, the claim's region's raiders (Data/spawn_regions.json 'raiders'): points of them, points + pointsPerHearthLevel x the claim's Hearth level, each costing its tier's cost. A raider goes for the nearest piece of the claim and bites it (its bite's damage x pieceDamageMult every biteSeconds; foundationPenalty / totemPenalty cm further away than they are, so walls go first), turns on anyone near as any hunter does, and after maxMinutes the rest leave. stepSeconds: how often the server looks. placeholder

world._comment: streamingRangeScale: how far the ground streams in around each player who joins a game, times the map loading range (256 m): 24 is 6 km, the whole island (5.7 km corner to corner) from anywhere, as the host has it (a server loads every cell); 0.7 measured it free in frame time on Epic and 0.3 GB more memory (Docs/PERFORMANCE.md). decorationDistanceScale: trees, rocks and cliffs drawn this many times further; undergroundMargin (cm): anyone this far under the island is put back on top (WRGameMode).
world._nodes: nodeCullDistance (cm): how far resource nodes (map-placed trees, rocks, ore, sulfur, lichen, berry and fibre plants) are drawn. ashCoatMin / frostCoatMin: the least ash / frost coat on a volcanic / tundra shrub (0..1; 0 is the pack's own and leaves many green; 0.85 greys them but every benchmark run with it hung the GPU, see WRWorldDressing.cpp).

significance._comment: Wildlife cost by distance (UWRSignificanceSubsystem, Docs/PERFORMANCE.md): a creature further than farRadius cm from every remote player (they're sent creatures within 150 m) and localFarRadius cm from a player on the server's own machine (a listen-server host sees further) ticks its body, movement and brain every farTickInterval s, moving in steps of up to farMaxStep s, and replication looks at it farNetUpdateRate times a second; back to every frame inside the radius minus margin. Bosses and ridden creatures always run every frame. Each creature is looked at once every slices frames (a slice per frame, which also spreads their slow ticks over different frames). enabled 0 turns it off (comparisons).

preload._comment: Art loaded by path when something first appears (creatures, caves, bodies, held weapons) is loaded in the background at map start instead (UWRPreloadSubsystem, Data/preload.json). enabled 0 turns it off (comparisons).

clock._comment: World clock: real minutes per in-game day, the hour a new server starts at, night from duskHour to dawnHour, twilightHours of fade either side. placeholder

fp._comment: Full-body first person (hero.md 2.7): the eye is the head bone after animation plus eyeForward / eyeUp cm; across the ground it follows 1:1, up and down a critically damped spring of halfLife s holds it within bob cm of the head. A roll drops the view rollDrop cm and back (no tumble) with a rollVignette flash.

anim._comment: How bodies animate (UWRAnimInstance). Crossfade seconds between any two states (blendSeconds), into / out of a one-shot (shotBlendIn / shotBlendOut); idle blends into walking over idleToWalk x the walk's pace; locomotion play rates stay within minRate..maxRate of each clip's measured pace; the upper layer takes the legs too below legsMovingSpeed cm/s. Turn in place: standing, the legs stay put while the facing swings, up to turnMaxDegrees; past turnThreshold a turn clip steps them round; moving, they catch up at turnCatchUp deg/s. Footsteps play within footstepRange cm of a local player. Creatures: turn at creatureSpinRate deg/s standing and creatureTurnRate on the move; with creatureArcTurns on, AI movement leads its facing by at most creatureLeadDegrees (curves, not sideways slides) and, nearly stopped and facing more than creatureSpinAngle away, creeps at creatureSpinCreep x speed while it turns on the spot; feet step at creatureTurnStep x radius per radian turned on the spot; idle plays at sleepIdleRate asleep. Attack clips are timed so the strike lands with the damage: creatureAttack.<move>.rate fixes a move's pace (0 = fit), snap/lunge/charge .hit = when the damage lands after the swing / windup, within creatureAttackMinRate..MaxRate.

mm._comment: The hero's motion matching (UWRHeroAnimInstance): searches every frame for your own hero, every remoteSearchInterval s for others; others at LOD fallbackLOD and past use player_art.json's fallback rows. New matches blend in over blendSeconds; the clip plays at the real ground speed over its own within minRate..maxRate (stride matching); the pose turns up to warpMaxDegrees onto the real travel (orientation warping). The trajectory looks futureSeconds ahead. landSeconds after touching down picks the landing clips. Top speeds at or below walkBelow cm/s use the walk databases. A foot below footContactHeight cm is planted (footsteps).

creatureFeet._comment: Creatures with the generated skeleton (Tools/art/rig_quadruped.py: <leg>_upper/_lower/_foot, 4 or 6 legs), or a pack skeleton whose legs creatures.json names ("legs"), on uneven ground (AWRCreature::TickCreatureFeet, FWRAnimProxy::PlaceCreatureFeet). Within range cm of a local view, while its pose updates, the ground under each foot is traced every frame and eased in (smoothing per second). The body tilts to the plane through those points (pitch front to back up to maxPitch degrees, roll side to side up to maxRoll, tiltScale x the ground's slope), turning about a point over the feet's middle at pivot x hip height (0 = at the feet, 1 = the hips: the legs stay under the body), sits at the plane's height and sinks up to maxDrop x its leg length so the lowest foot reaches; each leg then reaches its own ground (two-bone IK, the knee bending as the clip bends it, a foot lifted at most maxRaise x leg length), the foot lying to its ground up to footMaxTilt degrees. It fades in / out over fadeSeconds (off in the air, swimming, out of range); dead, the legs let go and the body stays lying to its ground. enabled 0 turns it off. creatureRandomPhase 1: each creature starts its idle and stride at its own point (seeded by where it spawned), so a pack doesn't move in unison. placeholder

creatureSpine._comment: Legless creatures with a spine chain (Tools/art/rig_special.py worm: Glacimaw) on uneven ground: the ground under every joint is traced like the creature feet (same range, smoothing, fade), and each spine bone turns up to maxBend degrees so the body lies along it. Off with creatureFeet.enabled 0. placeholder

artCam._comment: WRArtCam (art checks, animshots, creaturevideo): the camera stands sizes x the subject's largest half-extent + extra cm away. Videos pass a tighter framing with -Tune.

creatureAI._rows: Attack rows (Data/attacks.json, cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.15): minWindup s (no faster tell), finalCueSeconds before a held strike's contact, maxProjectileSpeed cm/s (Fire / Frost; never homing), offscreen (a wind-up starts only within offscreenHalfAngle degrees of its target's view, or within offscreenAudibleRadius cm), readsActionCooldown s, stomp waves (waveSpeed cm/s, waveDepth cm), breathe (after a string: min-max s, at distance.min-max cm), flank (inner-outer cm ring, tolerance cm), withdraw (a quarter of its stance in window s: shelled up seconds, damageTaken x, strikeMult x), howl callRadius, pulling (a hit from beyond pullRange cm alerts packmates within pullAlertRadius cm that see it).
creatureAI._comment: Wild creature behaviour. Hunting: carnivores get hungry every huntIntervalMinutes (x0.75-1.25), hunt the nearest wild non-carnivore up to preySizeRatio x their own radius (pack hunters packPreySizeRatio), eat a kill for eatSeconds (every hunter on it within shareKillRadius shares it), retry huntRetrySeconds after prey gets away; prey notice a hunter within preyNoticeRadius and bolt in bursts (preyRestSeconds between runs); a hunter in pursuit runs at huntSpeedMult and follows prey up to huntLeash cm from home. Morale: flee below fleeHealth, or below packFleeHealth when a packmate died in the last packLossSeconds, for fleeSeconds at fleeSpeedMult. Sleep: aggro x sleepAggroMult asleep, x nightAggroMult for night hunters at night; a hit keeps it awake wokenSeconds. Attacks: min/max range cm, windup s (telegraphed), cooldown s, damageMult x its bite, poise, plus per-move numbers. placeholder

bite._flags: impact 1-5 (poise.reactions), parryable, low (passes under a jump) per move; a blocked creature blow costs defense.creatureStaminaDamage x its damage.
bite._bite: its snap at running prey (prey can't block or dodge; at survivors it swings its bite ability)

telegraph._comment: Creature attack wind-ups, the look (WRCreature.cpp; how long each lasts is the attack's own windup: creature.biteTiming, creatureAI.<kind>). From the swing's start to its move the creature glows (M_WindupGlow over its materials: a flash for flashSeconds, then startGlow building to full; glow x opacity, wash = how much of the body fills in besides the rim; color sRGB, one for every creature) and rears back, reaching the pose by poseBy of the wind-up: pitch degrees (+ nose up on the hind feet, - head down on the front), back x its radius, sink x its half height. After the move it springs forward over releaseSeconds. Bosses glow but keep their own clips. glow 0: no glow at all (Raven 2026-11-01: the attack clips wind up on their own; the rear-back and growl stay). enabled 0 turns it all off. placeholder

look._comment: Camera look from the mouse and the pad's right stick, and held-input isolation. Settings > Look and controller multiplies the speeds (sensitivity 0.1-4) and can invert up/down; neither is inverted by default (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.15).
look._pad: pad*: degrees a second at full tilt and sensitivity 1; curve > 1 makes small tilts finer.
look._flick: Locked on, the right stick past flickThreshold moves the lock to the nearest target that way on screen; it has to fall under flickRearm before the next flick.
look._isolation: After leaving a menu, wheel, page, build placing or a mount, gameplay presses wait this long (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS L8).

pad._comment: The pad in menus (WRPadInput): the left stick moves the cursor, the D-pad jumps it to the next button, the right stick scrolls.
pad._cursor: cursorSpeed: pixels a second at full tilt on a 1080-high screen (scaled with the screen); cursorOverTarget: the speed over something clickable.

report._comment: Report a problem (F8 / View on a pad): where reports go, the picture's size, retries and the trip from a client to the host.

reactions._comment: Element reactions (FULL-GAME 4.2, cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.10): the last element to strike a body clings for window s; a different one landing inside it reacts and uses it up. Two players' elements meeting (or the owner of the pair) react in full, one player alone at nonOwnerScale. Fire then frost = the steam burst: damage, poise, soak and blind to everyone within radius cm. Lightning on a soaked body: + damage share and a shockChance free shock.

wildbrands._comment: Wildbrands (combat.md 2.12): a weapon art slotted and fired through the held weapon. fits: the classes it works with (empty: every melee class; a slot that doesn't fit greys out with the reason); windup / active / recovery s; dmg x the class's light (heavy for heavy arts) hit; stance x the class's light stance; buildup per hit; ha: hyperarmor through it; heat / chill: what it builds; stamina; charge (hold the slot: max s, dmg x at max); followUp (a second press from its combo window until window s after it: dmg, windup); mounted: usable from the saddle. Raven's spells.<art> numbers are the fallback.

potions._comment: The drink (CAL 1.10, combat.md 2.16): drinkSeconds committed (no cancelling), the heal lands at healAt s, walking at walkMultiplier meanwhile; one sharedCooldown s for every drink on the belt. A stagger mid-drink loses it.

mounted._comment: Fighting from the saddle (combat.md 2.19): Light swings to the side the camera faces, Heavy rears and strikes ahead (running-attack rows). A spear at couchSpeed cm/s or more: hold Heavy to couch it for couchSeconds: the first body within couchRadius of its line couchReach cm ahead takes couchDamage x the heavy, couchStance x stance, impact 5. A hit of unhorseImpact or more (or one that staggers the mount) throws the rider (unhorseKnockdown s down). The mount bites its rider's lock target every mountBiteSeconds when in reach.

pvp._comment: Player against player (combat.md 2.20, ER patch 1.07): damage x global, then x the weapon class's pvp (Data/weapons.json), Wildbrands x wildbrand, spells x spell, a tame's bite x tameDamage; status buildup x buildup. Crits: crit.pvpBackstabArc, crit.pvpDamage, crit.riseIFrames. combatTagSeconds: hitting or being hit by a player holds you in the fight (no fast travel, no changing where you wake, no clan storage); logging out meanwhile leaves your body in the world logoutBodySeconds.
